products.name: AI GPU / NPU hardware
products.description: Custom neural processing unit (NPU) architecture with Massive Matrix Math Units (MMUs), systolic array cores for FP8/INT4 inference, SRAM-dense near-memory compute, and dynamic sparsity handling. Target process node 4nm/5nm.
products.notes: Product not yet commercially launched; first silicon samples expected late 2026

products.name: Unified Compiler Ecosystem
products.description: Open-standard runtime compiler supporting PyTorch, JAX, and ONNX directly to bare-metal machine code. Reduces dependency on proprietary stacks like CUDA.

products.name: Full-stack AI compute platform
products.description: End-to-end AI compute platform covering GPU architecture, compilers, libraries, system software, and AI frameworks for enterprise and datacenter workloads.
products.notes: Described on official website; AGORA, Ksheera, SVCA product names NOT found in any public source
